rootCause: ArchiveCache selected the first capable ubershader. Optional Transmission/Volume flags let ordinary specular/IOR surfaces use a static screen-space refraction shader. FADE hair then entered REFRACT rather than BLENDED and opaque skin could overwrite it as view-dependent sort keys changed.
fix: Require Transmission for transmission specs and Volume for volume specs. Material factors and geometry remain authored; normal opaque/alpha passes restored.

nativeMaterialRegression.backend: NOOP; real installed Filament provider and archive, no GPU
nativeMaterialRegression.controls: OPAQUE/MASK/BLEND; base, specular, IOR, clearcoat, actual transmission and volume

diagnostics: DLSS5_DEMO_CAPTURE_HIDDEN=1 hides only opt-in scripted capture windows; normal interactive launch unchanged. Temporary depth/culling/color/orbit probes removed.
limitations: This fixes the reproduced view-dependent wrong draw pass; no claim to eliminate all intersecting-transparent-triangle artifacts.
